findings.title: Regression test still has an additional non-P04 failure
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 3 requires conclusions supported by evidence; criterion 4 requires the prompt’s stop conditions to be honored.
findings.trigger: The t2 full suite runs against the current uncommitted checkpoint state.
findings.consequence: Test 7 cannot pass because its amended expected result permits exactly 29 P04 IDs and explicitly forbids every additional failure.
findings.evidence: Section 3 reports t2 exit=1 with 30 new IDs: the 29 allowlisted P04 failures plus `tests/refactor_repo/test_inventory.py::test_baseline_compare_detects_changed_behavior`. The current prompt says, “No unnamed or additional failure is permitted; every other test must pass.” A temporary-commit experiment showing that the extra test may pass later does not make the current checkpoint test pass.

findings.title: Independent QA test remains incomplete
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 3 says an unavailable or inconclusive check is not PASS; criterion 7 requires witnessed and verified `QA_PASSED` before completion.
findings.trigger: The exact v3 artifact is evaluated before an independent passing verification exists.
findings.consequence: Test 8 and the overall checkpoint completion gate remain open.
findings.evidence: Test 8 states “In progress.” Section 8 schedules commit and post-commit verification only after a future `QA_PASSED`; neither is evidence available for this artifact.

findings.title: The current report still lacks exact evidence for Tests 1–6
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 3 requires the gated report to record every prompt test’s exact command or inspection procedure, exit status, material output, and supported conclusion.
findings.trigger: A reviewer attempts to reproduce Tests 1–6 from v3 and its evidence.
findings.consequence: The six PASS conclusions are not independently reproducible from the current artifact.
findings.evidence: V3 merely says Tests 1–6 were reverified and refers to deprecated v2. V2 itself used incomplete procedures previously found insufficient: Test 1 lacked a complete inspection procedure/status; Test 2 used an incomplete `wc -l` invocation and did not preserve the required pre-move dry run; Test 5 contained `...`, `<repo root>`, and abbreviated Python commands.

findings.title: The final delta includes a path not authorized by the amended prompt
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 2 requires every mutation to fall within the prompt’s authorized boundary; criterion 4 forbids borrowing mutation authority.
findings.trigger: The v3 delta is checked against the current `authorized_paths` list.
findings.consequence: Authorized-path conformance cannot pass, regardless of the asserted operator amendment.
findings.evidence: `evidence/git_status_porcelain_v3.txt` records `M plans_internal/refactor_repo/prompts/P03_source_move.prompt.v3.yaml`. The amended prompt authorizes the resolved manifest and other narrow compatibility paths, but does not include its own `P03_source_move.prompt.v3.yaml` path. The report’s claim that every changed path is inside the amended boundary is therefore false.

findings.title: Per-deliverable diff or digest coverage is still incomplete
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 6 requires a reviewable diff or immutable digest for every deliverable.
findings.trigger: Untracked checkpoint, exception, execution, source-package, and receipt-history trees are reviewed.
findings.consequence: Individual files within those collapsed directories cannot all be authenticated from the supplied final evidence.
findings.evidence: `git_status_porcelain_v3.txt` collapses several untracked trees to directory entries, including `checkpoints/P03/`, `exceptions/`, `execution/P03/`, `src/curriculum_factory/langgraph_factory/`, and one receipt-history directory. `git_diff_stat_v3.txt` excludes untracked content, while the available digest manifests cover only the source and runtime-test trees, not every checkpoint, exception, execution, prompt, receipt-history, and QA deliverable.

observations: The six original non-P04 failures were materially addressed, and the earlier frozen-manifest diagnosis was transparently corrected to the persisted receipt files.
The amended 29-item P04 allowlist appears to match 29 of the 30 new t2 IDs; the surviving blocker is the explicitly additional commit-sequencing failure.
reasoning: The history accurately records both verdicts I issued. V3 improves the substantive regression set, but its own literal Test 7 contract is not met because one additional failure remains. The report also identifies QA and post-commit verification as future work, and the amended delta contains an unauthorized self-prompt edit plus incomplete deliverable integrity coverage.
